title: Marv Review Schema

MutationID.description: a unique SHA-256 hash for a particular mutation based on a mutations operator, file, range and repalcement string

description: Array of reviews that correspond to a particular mutation id

items.description: A review which contains a unique id, framework name and review text

FrameworkMutationID.description: An optional field which contains the id assigned to the mutation by the mutation testing framework if one was created

Framework.description: The name of the mutation testing framework that generated the mutation

Review.description: The textual review of the mutation
